name: citation-entailment-v1
license: synthetic, CC0 — hand-written examples, no external corpus
description: Small labeled claim/evidence set for the M5 entailment assessor. Each item is a claim, a list of evidence passages, and the expected structured label (supports/contradicts/insufficient). Synthetic and legally shareable; NOT Google's private set. Human audit and threshold selection are an external gap (no annotator panel).

items.claim: Kinase X inhibition reduces AML tumor growth.
passages: Kinase X inhibition reduces AML tumor growth in multiple cell lines.
items.label: supports

items.claim: Blocking receptor Y restores immune surveillance.
passages: Receptor Y blockade restores immune surveillance in murine models.
items.label: supports

items.claim: Metabolic reprogramming via Z sensitizes cells to therapy.
passages: Z-driven metabolic reprogramming sensitizes cells to therapy.
items.label: supports

items.claim: Kinase X inhibition reduces AML tumor growth.
passages: Kinase X inhibition did not reduce AML tumor growth in this cohort.
items.label: contradicts

items.claim: Drug A improves survival in glioblastoma.
passages: Drug A showed no significant survival benefit in glioblastoma.
items.label: contradicts

items.claim: Gene G is associated with disease D.
passages: We found no association between gene G and disease D.
items.label: contradicts

items.claim: Compound C is effective against pathogen P.
passages: Compound C was ineffective against pathogen P at all doses.
items.label: contradicts

items.claim: Inhibiting kinase X reduces tumor growth in AML cells.
passages: This review discusses cardiac tissue development in zebrafish.
items.label: insufficient

passages: An unrelated study of soil microbiome diversity.
items.label: insufficient

items.claim: Target T is druggable in solid tumors.
passages: A general commentary on the history of oncology funding.
items.label: insufficient

items.claim: Protein Q folds via a two-state mechanism.
passages: Protein Q folding proceeds through a two-state mechanism without intermediates.
items.label: supports

items.claim: Vaccine V elicits durable antibody responses.
passages: Vaccine V did not elicit durable antibody responses beyond six months.
items.label: contradicts
